name: Supermarine Spitfire Mk IX
summary: The best known fighter of the Second World War, here in the Mk IX version: an elliptical wing and a two-stage supercharged Merlin. About 5,600 were built from 1942.

takeoff.note: Approximate: clean, mid weight, tail raised on the roll

verify.note: The FlightGear model measures 9.13 m long against the Mk IX's published 9.47 m: its fuselage keeps the early marks' shorter nose (9.12 m), not the longer one the two-stage Merlin brought. It stands 3.78 m tall on its tail wheel against the published 3.86 m.
